### [Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/21/cloudflare-python-worker/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-21

Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available after a two-year preview, providing first-class Python support on Cloudflare's server-side platform.

- Python runs via Pyodide compiled to WebAssembly inside Cloudflare's V8-based workerd runtime.
- Multiprocessing and threading are non-functional due to WebAssembly VM limitations.
- Local development via pywrangler (workers-py on PyPI) uses a 123MB workerd binary to execute Pyodide in WebAssembly within V8.

**Why it matters:** Developers can deploy Python applications directly to Cloudflare's edge network using Pyodide and WebAssembly without managing underlying server infrastructure.

`python` `cloudflare` `webassembly` `pyodide`
